description: This file defines the 'AccountingDropdownReadPlatformService' interface, providing method signatures for retrieving various accounting-related options and mappings, primarily used for dropdowns in user interfaces.

classes.name: AccountingDropdownReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface providing methods to retrieve accounting-related dropdown options and account mappings.

methods.name: retrieveGLAccountTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns a list of options for GL account types.

methods.name: retrieveGLAccountUsageOptions
methods.description: Returns a list of options for GL account usages.

methods.name: retrieveJournalEntryTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns a list of options for journal entry types.

methods.name: retrieveAccountingRuleTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns a list of options for accounting rule types.

methods.name: retrieveAccountMappingOptionsForLoanProducts
methods.description: Returns a map of account mappings for loan products.

methods.name: retrieveAccountMappingOptionsForSavingsProducts
methods.description: Returns a map of account mappings for savings products.

methods.name: retrieveAccountMappingOptionsForCharges
methods.description: Returns a map of account mappings for charges.

methods.name: retrieveAccountMappingOptions
methods.description: Returns a general map of account mappings.

methods.name: retrieveAccountMappingOptionsForShareProducts
methods.description: Returns a map of account mappings for share products.

methods.name: retrieveExpenseAccountOptions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of expense account options.

methods.name: retrieveAssetAccountOptions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of asset account options.
